headline: ZF Banking Supplement. Analysis. Ranking of banks by equity. How well capitalized are Romanian banks. Which banks increased their capital and which reduced it in 2025. How the solvency of the banking system evolved
summary: Romanian banks held cumulative equity of 88.5 billion lei at the end of 2025, up 9.4 billion lei, or nearly 12%, from 2024, according to NBR data.
why: Bank capital levels determine lending capacity and solvency, which investors track when assessing the Romanian banking sector.
